title: 13-Week Cash Flow Forecast for Small Business

listing.description_html:
See every week's cash position for the next quarter, spot the tight weeks before they happen, and track forecast against actual.

Monthly profit-and-loss reports hide timing. A month can be profitable on paper while payroll lands two days before the biggest customer pays. A weekly view shows that gap in advance, while there is still time to move a payment, chase an invoice or arrange a credit line.

What's included

  • Weekly view of the next 13 weeks: receipts, payments by category, net cash flow and closing balance
  • Automatic BELOW BUFFER flag for any week under the minimum balance you set
  • Summary: quarter totals, ending cash, lowest balance, number of tight weeks
  • Variance sheet to compare your real bank balance with the forecast each week
  • Formulas locked against accidental overwrites; inputs clearly marked in yellow
  • PDF guide with a worked example and a field-by-field reference

Who it's for

  • Owners of small and service businesses who pay staff weekly or bi-weekly
  • Freelancers and agencies with lumpy client payments
  • Bookkeepers preparing a cash view for a client or a bank
  • Anyone asked by a lender for a short-term cash forecast

You get: 13_week_cash_flow_forecast.xlsx (Inputs, Forecast, Summary, Variance) and this guide.

Works in Excel 2016 or later, Excel for Mac and Excel on the web; opens in Google Sheets and LibreOffice.

This workbook is a planning tool, not accounting, tax or financial advice. Its results are only as accurate as the figures you enter; check important decisions with a qualified accountant.
